describesHead.landingTitle: docs(arch): define the declarative configuration envelope and captured (#809)

rule: Each case states its input, the required outcome with exact work and audit counts, and the forbidden outcome, and names the node whose test makes it executable. DEM0 ships no test; the executable owner adds it. Work counts are per profile and per epoch over five work families: framework projection, script-fact capture, TypeInfo operation, index contribution and carrier parse, plus semantic-oracle calls made by activation. Audit records follow DR28: one ActivationPlanned per stage-one plan (one source unit under one activation epoch), counting that plan's regions only, and one DemandPlanned per stage-four plan (one request or batch). An epoch emits as many ActivationPlanned records as source units it plans, never one workspace-wide record. Cases DC01-DC05 run under UAO0-AC-R2.

cases.name: disabled profile
cases.input: A workspace with a Vue 3 package and a Svelte 5 package, both admitted releases. The effective configuration sets frameworks.svelte = off. The client opens, edits and hovers App.svelte, then requests diagnostics.
cases.required: App.svelte keeps its CarrierProfileId. Its Svelte region is Dormant { Off }. Svelte work: 0 framework projection, 0 script-fact capture, 0 TypeInfo operations, 0 index contributions; carrier parse runs only if a non-Svelte demand needs the carrier. Audit: exactly one ActivationPlanned for App.svelte's stage-one plan under that epoch, with dormant = 1 for its Svelte region, and no DemandPlanned containing a Svelte capability. Other source units planned in the same epoch emit their own ActivationPlanned records. Vue files in the same workspace are unaffected.
cases.forbidden: Any Svelte projection, script-fact or TypeInfo work; reclassifying App.svelte as a TypeScript script; a per-request audit record for the dormant region; a filtered or re-minted CatalogSnapshot
cases.evidenceNote: The existing tests pin today's process-flag narrowing (DEM-D02, D09), which this case replaces; they discriminate the zero-work half only.

cases.name: selected but unrequested profile
cases.input: A Vue 3 package with Comp.vue whose Vue region is Selected. No request names Comp.vue: the client has it closed, participation for its selector is workspace, and no index or batch demand reaches it.
cases.required: Vue work for Comp.vue: 0 framework projection, 0 script-fact capture, 0 TypeInfo operations, 0 carrier parse. Audit: at most one ActivationPlanned for Comp.vue's stage-one plan and 0 DemandPlanned naming Comp.vue.
cases.forbidden: Projection, parse or component-information work triggered by selection alone; eager diagnostics publication or prewarm for an unrequested file
cases.evidenceNote: No existing test pins selected-but-unrequested work for a carrier; DEM-D01 and DEM-D06 are the eager routes this case replaces.

cases.name: ambiguous region
cases.input: A test catalog with two semantic profiles that both claim the TSX carrier, both active for one package, with no @jsxImportSource pragma and no declared T06 relation. The catalog is built twice with the two profiles registered in opposite orders.
cases.required: Every region of the file is Ambiguous { claims } naming both AttachmentIds, identically under both registration orders. Profile work: 0 framework projection, 0 script-fact capture, 0 TypeInfo operations for either profile. Audit: one ActivationPlanned for that source unit's stage-one plan, with ambiguous equal to that file's region count. The ambiguity diagnostic is reported once per epoch (DR22). Adding the pragma for one profile selects that profile for that file only.
cases.forbidden: First-registered, first-loaded or fastest profile wins; a merge of both profiles' results; a warm cache entry for the ambiguous outcome
cases.evidenceNote: Today two rows claiming one carrier language fail registration; the per-region ambiguity outcome has no current route (empty population).

cases.name: missing package
cases.input: A package whose manifest declares vue but whose installed version PM cannot resolve (node_modules absent, lockfile present). A prepared-input host omits node_modules/vue/package.json without proving it absent.
cases.required: The Vue region is Unproven { needs } naming the missing proof. Vue work: 0 framework projection, 0 script-fact capture, 0 TypeInfo operations. The outcome is ReturnOnly and nothing is cached warm. Once PM proves the installed version, a new epoch selects the profile (admitted release) or yields Dormant { UnsupportedVersion }.
cases.forbidden: Activation from the declared range or the package name; Inactive or Dormant cached as a warm negative; Vue semantics served from a guessed default major

cases.name: rapid mode change
cases.input: With a long TypeInfo request in flight on App.vue under epoch E1, the frameworks.vue value flips auto -> off -> auto within one debounce window, minting E2 and E3; a second request is queued but not admitted before E2.
cases.required: The in-flight E1 request completes ReturnOnly or is cancelled and is never published warm; no result is served after E2 is observed. The queued request is never admitted under E2. Only E3's plan runs. Audit: one ActivationPlanned for App.vue's stage-one plan under each minted epoch that plans it (E1, E2, E3), and one DemandPlanned only for each admitted demand plan. E3's answers equal a fresh host at E3.
cases.forbidden: A stale E1 answer published or served after E2; work admitted under a superseded epoch; E3 reusing an entry warmed under E1, including a refusal
cases.evidenceNote: These pin revision supersession and pre-admission cancellation for compile and dispatch; no activation epoch exists today.

cases.name: post-snapshot facts cannot mutate the current generation
cases.input: App.vue's stage-one plan selects the Vue profile from the activation record. After the project snapshot publishes, import resolution shows that the only role-bearing import resolves to a userland module, not the canonical vue export.
cases.required: Stage two records Withdrawn { cause } for that snapshot. The stage-one generation, its carrier artifacts and its projection are unchanged and not re-run. Stage one makes 0 semantic-oracle calls. A later change to a selection input reaches stage one only as a new epoch.
cases.forbidden: Stage two adding a profile, changing the carrier or re-running projection under the same generation; stage one calling TypeScript, the shared resolver or TypeInfo
cases.evidenceNote: script_fact_capture_is_syntax_only pins the syntax-only capture half that stage one generalizes.

cases.name: spelling never activates
cases.input: A plain TypeScript package with no framework dependency containing: a file named nuxt.config.ts, a userland defineComponent import from a local module, an import of the string 'svelte' resolving to nothing, and a file with a .server.vue suffix in a Vue package without Nuxt facts.
cases.required: No profile is selected for any of them. Activation work: 0 for every profile. No Nuxt profile applicability is attached.
cases.forbidden: Activation from a file name, extension suffix, import specifier spelling or exported name
cases.evidenceNote: is_ssr_file_detection pins today's suffix rule (DEM-D05), which this case forbids.

cases.name: process admission is not selection
cases.input: Two hosts over one workspace: host A with no admission option and a user layer setting frameworks.svelte = off; host B with the default user layer.
cases.required: Both hosts carry the same CatalogSnapshot identity. In host A every .svelte region is Dormant { Off } and keeps its CarrierProfileId; host B selects the Svelte profile. A framework-surface request naming the Svelte profile on host A returns a typed outcome chosen by COX0 under CAT-F01, never a fabricated empty surface.
cases.forbidden: A process flag or init option filtering or re-minting the catalog; different catalog identities between hosts A and B; a dormant profile answering as an empty supported surface
cases.evidenceNote: These pin today's admission validation and the typed MalformedPayload for an unregistered adapter (CAT0 RM02).

cases.name: per-file pragma narrowing
cases.input: A React package with an admitted React release and an admitted Solid release installed; widget.tsx carries @jsxImportSource solid-js.
cases.required: widget.tsx selects the Solid profile for its regions; every other .tsx file in the package selects React. Neither file is Ambiguous.
cases.forbidden: The pragma narrowing other files; React and Solid both selected on widget.tsx

cases.name: unsupported version is dormant
cases.input: A package with svelte 4 installed and only Svelte 5 admitted.
cases.required: Every Svelte region is Dormant { UnsupportedVersion }. Svelte work: 0 framework projection, 0 script-fact capture, 0 TypeInfo operations. Audit: one ActivationPlanned per Svelte source unit's stage-one plan under that epoch, each with dormant equal to that unit's region count.
cases.forbidden: Coercing to Svelte 5; serving Svelte 5 semantics for the file

cases.name: deterministic batch membership and order
cases.input: A BatchCheck demand over 20 Vue and Svelte files submitted twice with the files discovered in reverse order and with different worker counts.
cases.required: Identical batch membership and identical canonical order of (SourceUnitId, RegionId, CapabilityId, fact demand) entries; identical answers; and one DemandPlanned per batch submission, identical across the two submissions.
cases.forbidden: Membership or order that depends on discovery, arrival or completion order

cases.name: isolated-root refusal reuse
cases.input: An Interactive request whose isolated root is refused under budget profile B1; the same request repeats; then repeats under budget profile B2 with a larger allowance; then repeats from a different root context.
cases.required: The repeat under B1 reuses the typed refusal with zero producer work only while purpose, budget profile, profile set, root context, demand epoch and root source identity are unchanged. B2 recomputes. The different root recomputes. A repeat under another demand epoch or another root source identity (SourceRevision plus ContentId, or MapRevision for a map) recomputes. No repeat reports the refused fact as exactly absent. A dependency admitted under the root needs no second root permit.
cases.forbidden: A refusal reused across purpose, budget profile, profile set, root context, demand epoch or root source identity; a refusal read as exact absence

cases.name: capture off performs no observation-only work
cases.input: The DC01 workspace with audit capture off.
cases.required: The same plans and answers as with capture on; 0 observation-only work (no audit record construction); required plan state (epoch, outcomes, refusals) is present.
cases.forbidden: Answers or plan state that differ with capture off; observation work performed with capture off

cases.name: capability without declared fact demands
cases.input: A test catalog row that registers a capability without a fact-demand declaration.
cases.required: Catalog construction fails with a typed error naming the capability and its profile.
cases.forbidden: The capability running with an implicit all-facts demand
cases.evidenceNote: The existing test pins the analogous fail-closed construction for a row without a grammar.

cases.name: cancellation during planning
cases.input: A DiagnosticsPublication plan for App.vue cancelled after stage one and before submission; a second cancelled after submission at an engine CancellationCheckpoint.
cases.required: Both publish nothing and leave no warm entry and no refusal. A retry answers what a fresh host answers.
cases.forbidden: A partial plan or partial diagnostics published; a cancellation recorded as a reusable refusal

cases.name: declared interoperability relation
cases.input: A test catalog declaring a nested T06 relation between a host carrier profile and an embedded-template profile, and separately a coexisting relation between two profiles with disjoint capabilities.
cases.required: Nested: the outer profile claims the host region and the inner profile claims its child regions. Coexisting: both claims are selected and each capability is served by exactly one profile. Both outcomes are identical under reversed registration order.
cases.forbidden: Order-dependent selection; both profiles serving one capability
